hooks.reads: cached or stored L1 block number
hooks.disposition: parent-domain counter, not L2 number or executing prefix

hooks.reads: L1-number-indexed 256-slot stored hashes; skipped numbers may be synthesized from previous L2 hash plus number
hooks.disposition: past/block-start data, never current-prefix hash; do not infer Ethereum L1 header from nonzero value

hooks.producer: StateDB balance mutations, transfers, protocol fees and native mint/burn
hooks.disposition: live selected scalar, not complete ordered prefix

hooks.producer: SetCode on deployment/code changes; code hash hashes code bytes only
hooks.disposition: code identity, not account/storage/global state commitment

hooks.reads: storage/transient storage at currently executing contract address and supplied key
hooks.disposition: selected values, no opcode exposing arbitrary StateDB IntermediateRoot or receipt trie

hooks.reads: current frame gas budget, paid message price, block base fee
hooks.producer: frame gas accounting; GasPriceOp/GetPaidGasPrice; block context and pricing
hooks.disposition: fee/counter facts can distinguish histories but do not commit ordered transfer content

hooks.reads: current frame/message inputs or results of a selected call
hooks.producer: message context and normal call execution
hooks.disposition: no implicit execution-history authenticity; calldata roots are supplied claims

hooks.reads: block context/config; Nitro header difficulty1, ArbOS Random derived from difficulty hash
hooks.producer: createNewHeader and NewEVMBlockContext; not current state/receipt/tx roots
hooks.disposition: block-level facts fixed before ordinary execution, not caller-position prefix

hooks.reads: message BlobHashes by supplied index; BLOBBASEFEE errors on Arbitrum
hooks.producer: current message blob fields, not earlier transactions

hooks.reads: exact32-byte L2 height; 393168 preceding hashes, current excluded
hooks.producer: system-address start-block write of previous L2 block hash to ring slot
hooks.disposition: ordinary nested call observed; completed-block-only, not prefix; no four-byte ABI selector

hooks.reads: RPC backend helper state, not ordinary EVM contract
hooks.producer: InterceptRPCMessage outside normal nested EVM dispatch
hooks.disposition: RPC-only; no native Migration capability; direct call result is not ordinary-call proof

hooks.reads: no code at inherited P/C observations
hooks.disposition: not an observed current-prefix oracle; hypothetical standard beacon roots are not adopted

activeMapLinkage.meaning: At source61, NewEVM derives Rules using BlockContext.ArbOSVersion; IsElara is true for Arbitrum and version>=60, so activePrecompiledContracts selects StartingFromArbOS60 containing all18 families plus Osaka primitives.
